---
title: "Man float probe"
shorttitle: "MAN PROBE"
author:
  - name: Test Author
    corresponding: true
    email: test@example.com
    affiliations:
      - name: Example University
abstract: >-
  Tall figures after text of varying length in single-column man, so that
  without apa-layout's man-floats option an [H] figure that misses the rest of
  a page moves to the next one and leaves the rest of the page blank. Rendered
  by tests/run.sh (man, PDF only); tests/man-gaps.py counts the blank pages.
keywords: [probe]
documentmode: man
floatsintext: true
apa-layout:
  man-floats: true
filters:
  - dtofighi/apa-layout
execute:
  echo: false
---
